## Brief

What this task is and why it exists.

## Files

The files or directories this task owns. `do not edit outside them` if dispatched
to a worker.

## Acceptance

The exact criteria and verifying command that prove this task is done.

## Log

Decisions, evidence, and the closing note (what landed, verifying run, where the
evidence lives).
